effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 Digimon card with the [SoC] trait and 1 such Tamer card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. If you added cards, trash 1 card in your hand.
